name: king_cobra_bulge
description: King cobra (Ophiophagus hannah): heavy olive #6b7a3a body, darker olive back #4f5a2a, thin pale cream chevron bands #e8e0a8 pointing toward the head and fading toward it, pale yellow throat #e8d890, large smooth head shields, small dark eye under a heavy brow, NARROW hood (barely wider than the neck; never the wide Naja disc). After the meal: lying stretched out with a long smooth plain bulge mid-body (top about (0,-108)), head at the right resting on the ground, eye half-closed, smug-flat. No outline of anything inside. Anchor bottom-centre; bbox x -520..+510, y -108..0. doug_cap goes on the ground beside it at about x +600.
